svg.title: Figure 1. Test set-up
svg.desc: Three panels. (a) Side view of the 6061-T6 tube clamped at its left end, with a lever at the free end pointing toward the viewer and a downward load F at the lever's tip; the gage section is 250 mm (L_b) from the load line, with rosette K on the near side at mid-height and rosette H on top; a hand pump connects to the end plug for Part C. (b) The cross-section seen from the free end: the lever extends 200 mm (a_L) to the left, which is the K side, the load F hangs from its tip, and the torque T acts about the tube's axis; H is at the top, K at the left, and the angle phi is measured from H toward K. (c) The rectangular rosette: gage a along the tube axis x, gage b at 45 degrees and gage c at 90 degrees counterclockwise from x, with the local y axis 90 degrees counterclockwise from x as seen from outside the tube.
